text.p: Managed care company WellPoint Health Networks Inc said on Tuesday its 10 million share offering was priced at $38 a share.

Of the shares being sold in the offering, three million shares are being offered by WellPoint. The remaining seven million shares are being offered by the California HealthCare Foundation, WellPoint's largest shareholder.
The company will not receive any proceeds from the offering of shares by the California HealthCare Foundation.

WellPoint said the net proceeds from the three million shares being offered by the company will be used to repay a portion of the outstanding indebtedness under its Subordinated Term Loan Agreement dated as of Nov 21, 1996.
The offering is being led by Salomon Brothers Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co, and is being co-managed by Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
The underwriters have been granted an option by the California HealthCare Foundation to purchase up to 1.5 million additional shares to cover over-allotments. Wellpoint said.
WellPoint's stock traded at 38-3/4, down 1, in afternoon trading.
